extDescription.message: Local AI assistant: summarize a page or a video, chat with a model, act on a selection, through a local program that runs on your machine.

common_error_auth_required.message: Authentication required with the model provider.

common_error_context_too_large.message: The content sent is too large for the model.

common_error_internal.message: Internal error in the local program.

common_error_quota_exceeded.message: Your account with the provider has no credit left.

common_error_rate_limited.message: The provider is getting too many requests right now.

common_extraction_timeout.message: The page is taking too long to read.

common_access_denied_hint.message: Click its icon, right-click → "Read this page with Coati", or use the keyboard shortcut.

panel_save_prompt.message: Save the typed text as a prompt

panel_auth_key_refused.message: ⚠ Key refused by the provider: check it in settings.

panel_auth_unknown.message: ⚠ The provider refused access (expired session or refused key): check settings.

panel_error_oversized.message: ⚠ The message sent exceeded the maximum size accepted by the local program (256 KB); the connection was closed. Try again with shorter content.

panel_error_model_unavailable.message: ⚠ The model isn't responding ($MESSAGE$). Coati's local program is working fine; the model is the problem. Try again in a moment.

panel_error_context_too_large_warn.message: ⚠ The content sent is too large for the model.

panel_banner_no_host.message: Coati can't find its local program on this computer. Install it, or use manual pairing if your browser is a Flatpak or a Snap.

panel_banner_broker_untrusted.message: Another program is answering in place of Coati's own, and couldn't prove it's trustworthy. Nothing was sent to it. Close that program, or restart Coati's local program, then try again.

panel_banner_no_token.message: The local program doesn't recognize this extension yet (id $EXT_ID$). Open its settings to allow it, then restart it.

panel_banner_disconnected.message: Coati's local program isn't responding. Open it on your computer, then click Retry.

panel_access_denied_question.message: ⚠ Coati doesn't have access to this page, the question wasn't sent. $HINT$

panel_read_error_question.message: ⚠ Couldn't read the page, the question wasn't sent: $DETAIL$

panel_access_denied_generic.message: ⚠ Coati doesn't have access to this page. $HINT$

panel_access_denied_relaunch.message: ⚠ Coati doesn't have access to this page, the retry wasn't sent. $HINT$

panel_read_error_relaunch.message: ⚠ Couldn't read the page, the retry wasn't sent: $DETAIL$

panel_transcript_missing.message: The transcript couldn't be read. Under the video: "…" → "Show transcript", then try again. If the button is absent, the video has no captions.

panel_worker_restarted.message: The request was interrupted (the background service restarted), retry it.

panel_no_response_130s.message: No response after 130s. The local program isn't responding; check that it's running, then try again.

panel_nothing_readable.message: ⚠ Nothing readable was found on this page. Content loaded later, or subscriber-only?

panel_request_in_progress.message: ⚠ A request is already in progress; try again after.

panel_prompt_saved_no_site.message: Saved, no site: Coati can't see this page's address.

panel_seek_timestamp_title.message: Jump to this moment in the video

panel_read_button_refused_note.message: Access refused. You can activate just this site, or click the Coati toolbar icon to read the page once.

panel_read_button_refused_note_unknown_s.message: Access refused. Click the Coati toolbar icon to read the page once, or try again.

panel_first_run_model_waiting.message: Model: waiting for the local program

panel_first_run_page_missing.message: Give it access to the page

panel_first_run_page_hint.message: Click "Read this page" at the top of the card. The browser will ask for access to all sites; Coati only reads a page when you click.

neverConnectedBody.message: Coati answers through an AI model, installed on your computer or online. The guide helps you connect one.

panelHelpPopoverText.message: Coati needs an AI model to answer: on your computer (free and private) or online (a key to create). The tutorial walks you through it step by step. Click this button to open it.

panel_unreadable_hint.message: Uncheck "Read the page" to ask a general question.

panel_unreadable_pdf.message: ⚠ Coati can't read a PDF displayed by the browser.

panel_unreadable_canvas.message: ⚠ This page is drawn (map, editor): Coati can't find any text to read there.

panel_unreadable_empty.message: ⚠ Coati finds almost no text on this page.

options_model_help.message: The model that answers your requests. This choice is saved by the local program, on this machine.

options_model_disconnected.message: The local program isn't responding: open it on your computer, then come back to this page to see or change the model.

options_attach_checkbox.message: Attach the open page to my questions

options_attach_help.message: Starting value of the panel's "Read the page" switch.

options_shortcut_help.message: To change it: about:addons, gear icon, then "Manage Extension Shortcuts".

options_sites_link_intro.message: The prompts suggested on each site are set in

options_history_help.message: The conversation is kept on this computer, unencrypted, then erased after this delay.

options_language_help.message: Coati's interface language (panel, settings, My prompts) and the language asked of the model for its replies.

options_legacy_title.message: Browser with no native program (Flatpak, Snap)

options_legacy_token_help_before.message: Only if your browser (Flatpak, Snap) cannot launch a native program. In a terminal, run

options_legacy_token_help_after.message: , then paste the secret here. It is never written to disk.

options_sites_help_gecko.message: On these sites, Firefox lets Coati see which site is open: the panel immediately offers the right buttons.

options_sites_help_chrome.message: On these sites, Chrome lets Coati see which site is open: the panel immediately offers the right buttons.

options_provider_desc_claude_api.message: Your own Anthropic key, billed to your account.

options_provider_desc_ollama.message: A model that runs on your machine: nothing leaves it.

options_provider_desc_openai_compat.message: An OpenAI-compatible server: LM Studio, Ollama, OpenAI, Mistral, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, or another address.

options_apikey_placeholder_optional.message: API key (optional, depends on the server)

options_address_refused.message: Address refused: HTTPS, or HTTP to localhost/127.0.0.1 only.

options_model_placeholder_openai_compat.message: exact name expected by the server

keyInput_placeholder_replace.message: Paste a new key to replace the current one

keyInput_verifying.message: Key saved, checking with the service…

keyInput_refused.message: The service refused this key: check that it was copied in full, or create a new one on its website.

keyInput_remedy_credit.message: Add credit on the service's website, then click “Check again”.

keyInput_remedy_wait.message: The key is saved: wait a minute, then click “Check again”.

keyInput_not_connected.message: The local program isn't responding: a key can't be saved right now.

keyInput_note_storage.message: The key is stored unencrypted on this computer, in a file only your user account can read.

keyInput_note_never_share.message: Never paste it anywhere else (chat, Discord, email): Coati will never ask you for it.

keyInput_note_spending_cap.message: Paid service: set a monthly spending cap on its website.

setup_open_link.message: Need help? Follow the step-by-step guide

setup_intro_need.message: To answer you, Coati needs an AI model.

setup_intro_local_program.message: The local program, installed with Coati on this computer, connects your browser to that model.

setup_not_connected.message: The local program isn't responding: the checks will work again as soon as it is running.

setup_path_local_text.message: Free and private: your texts never leave the computer. Needs a recent computer.

setup_path_online_text.message: Simpler: create a key with a service. Free or paid, depending on the service.

setup_check_unknown.message: The check didn't complete. Try again in a moment.

setup_try_text.message: Open any web page, then click the Coati icon in the browser toolbar. If it isn't there, click the puzzle-piece icon and pin Coati.

setup_local_install_text.message: Ollama is free software that runs the model on your computer.

setup_local_linux_install.message: On Linux, you can also install it from a terminal:

setup_local_start_windows.message: Open Ollama from the Start menu; its icon appears next to the clock.

setup_local_start_mac.message: Open Ollama from the Applications folder; its icon appears in the menu bar.

setup_local_start_linux.message: The installer starts it for you. If it isn't running, run this command in a terminal:

setup_local_running_text.message: Coati will switch to Ollama and check that it responds on this computer.

setup_local_unreachable.message: Ollama isn't responding. Check that it is running (step 1), then try again.

setup_local_model_text.message: Pick the row that matches your computer's memory (RAM). More memory allows a more capable model, but a bigger download.

setup_local_memory_known.message: Your browser says this computer has at least $GB$ GB of memory (it never reports more than 8 GB).

setup_local_memory_unknown.message: Your browser doesn't report this computer's memory: check your system information.

setup_local_pull_text.message: Open a terminal (Windows: PowerShell; macOS: Terminal), paste this command, then wait for the download to finish.

setup_local_model_missing.message: The model $MODEL$ isn't in Ollama yet: run the command above and wait for the download to finish.

setup_local_no_model.message: No model is installed in Ollama yet: run the command above.

setup_lmstudio_text.message: LM Studio is another app that runs a model on your computer. Install it, download a model from the app, then start its local server (“Developer” tab, “Start Server” button).

setup_lmstudio_ok.message: LM Studio is responding. Pick its model in the “Model” section below.

setup_online_free_warning.message: Before you choose: OpenRouter's free models may keep the texts you send them, and use them. Don't send anything confidential.

setup_online_free_detail.message: Free models: up to $PERDAY$ questions a day, $WITHCREDIT$ if you buy at least $CREDIT$ of credit.

setup_online_paid_detail.message: Paid: about $COST$ per question on a page of about $WORDS$ words.

setup_online_account_title.message: Create an account and a key

setup_online_account_text.message: Create an account (or sign in), open the API keys page, create a key, then copy it.

setup_online_openrouter_privacy.message: If a free model refuses to answer, allow free models in OpenRouter's privacy settings.

setup_online_paid_billing.message: Paid service: add a payment method or credit, then set a monthly spending cap (reminder in the next step).

setup_online_prepaid.message: Prepaid service: you buy credit in advance and never spend more than that credit.

setup_online_key_text.message: A key from this service usually starts with “$PREFIX$”.

welcome_lead.message: Coati summarizes a page or a video and answers your questions about what you're reading, with the model of your choice, through a program that runs on your machine.

welcome_pin_step1_chromium.message: Click the extensions icon (the puzzle piece), to the right of the address bar.

welcome_pin_step3_chromium.message: Coati's icon then stays in the toolbar: a click opens the panel.

welcome_pin_step1_gecko.message: Click the extensions button (the puzzle piece), to the right of the address bar.

welcome_pin_step2_gecko.message: Click the gear icon next to "Coati", then "Pin to Toolbar".

welcome_pin_step3_gecko.message: Coati's icon then stays in the toolbar: a click opens the sidebar.

welcome_program_text.message: Coati goes through a small program installed on your computer: it talks to the model and keeps your keys, never the extension.

welcome_model_text.message: In settings: a model that runs on your own machine (Ollama), or an online service with your own key.

welcome_page_text_chromium.message: Click Coati's icon, then "Read this page" at the top of the panel. The browser will ask once for access to all sites.

welcome_page_text_gecko.message: Click Coati's icon, then "Read this page" at the top of the sidebar. Firefox will ask once for access to all sites.

welcome_gesture.message: Coati only reads a page when you click: never in the background, never on a tab switch.

prompts_intro.message: A case holds a site's prompts: Coati's suggestions and yours, mixed together, in the order you choose.

prompts_all_sites_line.message: Coati has access to all sites, and only reads a page when you click.

prompts_banner_no_token.message: Local program not connected — open the extension's settings to pair it.

prompts_banner_disconnected.message: The local program isn't responding — open it on your computer, then come back to this page to see or edit your prompts.

prompts_action_title.message: Built-in action: reads the video's captions

sw_request_superseded.message: A newer request took priority; this one was dropped.

sw_broker_silent_15s.message: The local program hasn't responded in 15s. Check that it's running on this machine, then try again.

sugg_youtube_key_points_prompt.message: List the video's key points, each with its timestamp.

sugg_youtube_fact_check_prompt.message: Point out the claims in the video that would be worth checking, and say why.

sugg_google_refine_prompt.message: Turn my search visible on this page into an advanced search: quotes for an exact phrase, site:, filetype:, exclusions with -, and a before:/after: bound if a time period is relevant.

sugg_google_compare_prompt.message: Compare the results on this page: what they have in common, what sets them apart, and which best answers my search.

sugg_google_sources_prompt.message: For each result on this page, say who the source is and whether it looks reliable on this topic.

sugg_wikipedia_essentials_prompt.message: Summarize this article in 5 essential points, in order of importance.

sugg_wikipedia_explain_prompt.message: Explain this article's topic simply, as if to someone discovering it.

sugg_wikipedia_dates_prompt.message: List the key dates mentioned in this article, with what happened at each.

sugg_reddit_thread_gist_prompt.message: Summarize what this thread says: the dominant opinion and the most-discussed points.

sugg_reddit_opposing_prompt.message: Point out the opposing views in this thread, and each side's main argument.

sugg_amazon_reviews_prompt.message: Summarize this product's reviews: the strengths and the most frequently reported flaws.

sugg_amazon_weaknesses_prompt.message: Point out the weaknesses reported in this product's reviews, even minority ones.
